description: Dikwella Widanage Hansawathi and Others v. Galappaththige Nenaseeli Dikwella Widanage Hansawathi and Others v. Galappaththige Nenaseeli View More before Hon. Rohini Marasinghe, J..
parties: Dikwella Widanage Hansawathi and Others v. Galappaththige Nenaseeli Dikwella Widanage Hansawathi and Others v. Galappaththige Nenaseeli View More
keywords: The Plaintiff instituted an action in the District Court of Hambantota seeking recovery of arrears of rent. Held — a tenant cannot make repairs or structural alterations to premises without the consent of the landlord and set off such expenditure against rent; under Section 13(1) of the Rent Act No. 7 of 1972 and the Rent (Amendment) Act No. 55 of 1980, the proper remedy is an application to the Rent Board; tenant is not entitled to improve tenanted premises contrary to the Housing and Town Improvement Ordinance; appeal dismissed.
legistation: Rent Act No. 7 of 1972 (Section 13(1)); Rent (Amendment) Act No. 55 of 1980; Housing and Town Improvement Ordinance
